body: Market prices a ~50% chance [EST] that IMCL keeps its hospital on workable terms (17x P/E vs peers ~48x; net cash 16% of mcap). Our view: no edge on the SC/GNCTD outcome; the evidence we found leans negative versus the company's own presentation (expiry and affidavit absent from AR FY26 and results notes; GNCTD abstained at the AGM and left its board seats empty; MD term ended without a successor; ROIC flattered by Re 1 land). Positive: net cash Rs 57/share, no debt, ARPP-led growth. Proves us wrong: a disclosed 30-year renewal near IMCL's own ask (10% IPD / 25% OPD incl. medicines) without a retrospective claim. Scored by thesis:paper-call:INDRAMEDCO:*.

title: Indraprastha Medical (INDRAMEDCO) variant view, Nov 2026: cheap because the hospital's land lease has expired and the Delhi government opposes renewal; no claimable mispricing
